entries.title: Accept lower levels
entries.requirement: A higher-level implementation MUST accept a lower-level package when its object types are supported. Missing signatures or history mean not claimed, not invalid data.

entries.title: Stable IDs survive uplift
entries.requirement: Uplift from a submission to a canonical object MUST retain every supplied portable ID and MUST report archive-added resolution in an uplift receipt.

entries.title: No silent strengthening
entries.requirement: An importer MUST NOT represent unsigned or unverified imported content as authenticated producer evidence.

entries.title: No silent downgrade
entries.requirement: An export that omits proofs, state, compartments, or extensions MUST declare itself lossy and enumerate every omission category and subject.

entries.title: Preserve or refuse
entries.requirement: Unsupported material MUST be preserved opaquely, preserved as a byte-exact containing pack, or refused; it MUST NOT be silently discarded.

entries.title: Registered semantics declare requirements
entries.requirement: Every registered type and predicate MUST declare a minimum guarantee level and required capabilities; material below those requirements remains inert.
